correctness.rationale: The complete 13-point incidence plane and 5,616 matrix group are enumerated. The exact 234 minimal nontrivial blocking six-sets are one orbit. Kernel dimension nine gives all quartics through a selected six-set and 567 scalar classes with precisely that rational locus. A regular-sequence Hilbert-series argument makes degree-seven partial-ideal rank 36 equivalent to geometric smoothness; independent Groebner chart elimination agrees on the exact same 222 smooth equations. Full 24-element stabilizer partitions them into nine orbits of 24 and one orbit of six, hence 51,948 full projective equations in ten orbits.

value.rationale: Six is the sharp minimum possible size of a nontrivial rational blocking set in PG(2,3), so the locus is mathematically canonical rather than a random numerical slice. Its intersection with geometrically smooth genus-three plane quartics and the unique order-four symmetry class determine a complete natural arithmetic-incidence stratum, useful as a small-field benchmark; the classification is not implied by point-set-only counts or general moduli parameterizations.
